'''Ramola''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Black Ajah]]. 

==Activities==
She takes part in the [[Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod|Battle in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'']] and is seen standing next to [[Alviarin Freidhen]], sending random blasts of [[One Power|Power]] away from them in order to try and draw [[Egwene al'Vere]] into a trap.

If she was with Alviarin, it is likely that she escaped and survived the battle.
